newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Rabo studies pact with PVF pension fund.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Rabo studies pact with PVF pension fund.

text.p: Co-operative Rabobank Nederland and unlisted pension fund PVF Pensioenen said on Tuesday they were considering a commercial cooperation.
"Both parties intend to start investigative talks at short notice," Rabo and PVF said in a joint statement.
A Rabo spokesman declined to detail what form any possible cooperation between the two unlisted financial institutes could take.
PVF manages the investments of about 90 Dutch corporate sector pension and welfare sector funds, with around 40 billion guilders under mangement.
PVF previously said it was the sixth largest institutional investor in the Netherlands.
